title: Product Manager - Growth
description:
**About Atlys**
---------------


Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.


Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.


Atlys is changing that.


We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries**. But we’re still early.

**The Role**
------------


We’re looking for a **Senior Product Manager \- Growth** to own a critical part of the Atlys growth engine and build product experiences that drive acquisition, activation, referrals and retention.


You’ll define the product direction, understand what makes users convert and come back, identify growth opportunities, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics and other teams to build experiments, growth loops, referral and rewards experiences that move key business metrics.


This is a high\-ownership role for someone who can operate across **product strategy, growth and execution**, navigate ambiguity, use data to make sharp decisions, and build product\-led experiences that scale across markets and customer segments.

**The Job**
-----------

* **Own product strategy and roadmap** for growth, defining priorities across acquisition, activation, engagement and retention based on customer behaviour, business impact and growth opportunities.
* **Build product\-led growth loops** by identifying opportunities across referrals, rewards, sharing, virality and network effects that drive organic user acquisition and repeat usage.
* **Drive acquisition and conversion** through experimentation, funnel optimisation and product improvements across landing experiences, onboarding, activation and core journeys.
* **Build and scale growth programs** across referrals, rewards, incentives and lifecycle experiences, using data and experimentation to improve CAC, conversion, engagement and retention.
* **Lead cross\-functional execution** by partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Analytics and other teams to define growth bets, run experiments, make trade\-offs and ship quickly.

**The Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------


You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Have 2\-6 years of product management experience, ideally in consumer technology, fintech, travel, mobility or another high\-growth B2C environment.
* Have strong product judgment and a track record of owning growth\-focused product areas across acquisition, activation, referrals, rewards, engagement or retention.
* Are highly analytical and comfortable using data, experimentation and customer insights to identify growth levers and make product decisions.
* Understand **product\-led growth** and have experience building loops, incentives, referral programs or experiences that turn users into acquisition channels.
* Have strong ownership, prioritisation and execution skills, and can work effectively with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing and cross\-functional stakeholders.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*

**What you can expect**
-----------------------


Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.


Here’s what you can expect:

* **Competitive compensation and equity** so you participate in the value you help create.
* **Comprehensive health insurance** covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* **A thoughtful leave policy** with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* **Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office**, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* **Learning \& development credits** to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* **Relocation support** to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* **Great tools to do your best work**, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* **An office designed for more than just work**, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

Our founders were recognized by **Forbes 30 Under 30** for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**About the Role**


We’re hiring a **Senior** **Paid Social Specialist** to lead performance\-driven campaigns across platforms like Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, and CTV. This role goes beyond execution, combining creative strategy, campaign management, and data analysis to drive results at scale.


You’ll own the full lifecycle of paid social campaigns, from building and optimizing to scaling accounts often exceeding $1M/month, while working closely with creative, brand, and analytics teams. We’re looking for someone deeply experienced in Meta direct response advertising, with a strong track record of selling products through paid social and a sharp understanding of short\-form video creative.


This is a fast\-paced, high\-accountability environment where you’ll collaborate directly with leadership to grow high\-performing U.S. brands. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious marketers operating at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

***This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Portugal, Brazil, and Spain.***

**What you'll do:**

* Plan, develop, and implement comprehensive paid media strategies primarily focused on Paid Social to increase brand visibility and recognition and drive new user acquisition and leads via paid media campaigns.
* Conduct thorough brand and website audits to understand our clients’ key value propositions, core products, and brand aesthetics and identify opportunities to successfully market them and make them stand out in the marketplace.
* Obsession with short form creative and direct response creative to convert customers — how to best sell a product, how to best construct a hook, how to best guide a client on how their advertising dollars should be spent behind winning creatives.
* Conduct competitive research to ensure success in the ad space and new acquisition audience targeting.
* Manage between 5\-10 Paid Media accounts (including but not limited to: Meta Ads, TikTok Pinterest, and other social platforms like Twitter and TikTok) on behalf of Darkroom clients, with aggregate monthly spends ranging between $80,000 \- $3M.

* Religious mastery of important KPIs like CPA, CAC, iROAS, nCAC, MER, aMER, CTR, TSR, and Hold Rate.
* Understand industry\-wide benchmarks throughout all steps in the e\-commerce marketing funnel.
* Implement real\-time, proactive, and reactionary ad\-buying decisions across multiple platforms in response to up\-or\-down trends happening on ads platforms (you will be in ad platforms daily).
* Preemptively develop quarterly strategies for clientele based on perceived success metrics, ad spends, YoY performance metrics, and projections.
* Deep dive into competitor research, industry knowns, and brand identity to manage client expectations and continually brainstorm new marketing initiatives, creative assets, copy, and review after results.
* Understand full\-funnel marketing strategies to ensure new customer acquisition is healthy within the broader e\-commerce equation.
* Understand client needs for success and preemptively deliver projections and forecasts that latter into client quarterly strategy.
* Willingness and openness to learn and understand e\-commerce P\&Ls with a comfortability engaging with financial metrics.

**What you'll need to be successful:**

* Mastery of the e\-commerce marketing funnel —\> offer to ad to landing page to conversion.
* 7\+ years minimum of paid media advertising experience within Paid Social, Meta in specific (building high converting funnels and driving quantifiable results).
* 5\+ years minimum managing paid social advertising for growing clients in the consumer space spending over $400k\+ minimum monthly aggregate spend.
* Expertise in developing, testing, and optimizing advertisement copy and short form video creative
* Expertise in creative consultation for successful Paid Social Ads that convert
* Background in data\-derived decision\-making and forecasting budgets/spend projections linked to perceived results
* Experience with all core e\-commerce revenue drivers, reporting on metrics that actually matter (CPA, CAC, iROAS, aMER, TSR, CTR, Hold Rate)

**What It's Like to Work at Darkroom**


Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world\-class talent building something remarkable.


We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

Applicant screening is a crucial step in our recruitment process. This stage may involve a brief phone interview or video call to evaluate your suitability for the position. * Comply with local regulations in all aspects of strategy, sales processes, client correspondence, financial promotions, administration, and complaint handling

* Ensure all entries captured on WMS are error free and that the entries are reconciled everyday.
* Achieve the operational standards for the business and work within agreed procedures and guidelines \- displaying high levels of integrity at all times
* Maintain awareness of operational risk and minimize the likelihood of it occurring including its identification, assessment, mitigation and control, loss identification and reporting in accordance with section B.1\.2 of the Group Operations FIM.
* Minimum concurrent audit comments and NIL reminders
* Ensure NIL frauds for any cases sourced /handled by the branch.
* Ensure use of RMP for activity management and referring leads to PRMs

The said role requires to balance customer servicing activity along with sales acquisition while ensuring the necessary growth in the existing portfolio coupled with minimal attrition.

**Additional Information**

title: Technical Product Manager - Recommendations
description:
**About Atlys**
---------------


Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.


Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.


Atlys is changing that.


We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries**. But we’re still early.

**The Role**
------------


We're looking for a **Technical Product Manager** to own data ingestion for Atlys Signals pod the team responsible for collecting, structuring and surfacing the real\-time signals that power Atlys' AI\-driven travel decisions.


You'll drive the pipelines, integrations and data quality that keep Signals reliable at scale.

**The Job**
-----------

* **Lead automation and AI/ML infrastructure initiatives** across data pipelines, model serving, evaluation and monitoring to build reliable, scalable systems.
* **Own end\-to\-end execution** across Engineering, Product, AI and Operations, driving initiatives from problem definition through delivery and impact measurement.
* **Translate complex technical and business requirements** into structured execution plans, accounting for AI constraints, dependencies, risks and scalability.
* **Track and improve AI system performance** through dashboards and metrics such as accuracy, latency, cost and model quality.
* **Drive cross\-functional alignment and responsible AI practices**, including guardrails, monitoring and human\-in\-the\-loop review.

**The Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------


You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Have 4 to 7 years as a Technical PM or Data PM, ideally owning data pipelines or ingestion systems
* Are comfortable with data architecture and APIs, ETL/ELT, schemas, data quality tooling etc.
* Are structured and detail\-oriented, able to prioritise across many sources and stakeholders.
* Are analytical, using pipeline and data\-quality metrics to guide decisions.
* Communicate well, aligning engineering, AI/ML and product teams around data needs.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*

**What you can expect**
-----------------------


Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.


Here’s what you can expect:

* **Competitive compensation and equity** so you participate in the value you help create.
* **Comprehensive health insurance** covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* **A thoughtful leave policy** with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* **Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office**, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* **Learning \& development credits** to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* **Relocation support** to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* **Great tools to do your best work**, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* **An office designed for more than just work**, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*
